lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple rows of high-luminance, circular pixel clusters positioned posterior to the branchial region, showing increased spatial separation and diameter in the posterior-most visible section of the flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a grid-like arrangement of high-luminance nodes on the mid-to-posterior lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A singular, prominent linear feature running horizontally along the dorsal-lateral transition, marked by a sharp high-contrast shadow-to-light gradient.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin exhibits a high density of smaller, relatively uniform high-luminance spots compared to the larger cluster arrangements on the lateral flank.
